name: Hold Monster
summary: Paralyzes a creature of any type that fails a Wisdom saving throw.

stats.effect: Choose a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Paralyzed condition for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.
stats.higherLevels: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 5.
